title: If Emiliano Martinez leaves Aston Villa on a permanent transfer during the 2026 summer transfer window, which club will he join?
background: Emiliano Martinez is an Argentina international goalkeeper who plays for Aston Villa.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official announcements from the clubs involved, corroborated by reliable sports reporting. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the acquiring club in Martinez's first confirmed permanent transfer away from Aston Villa during the 2026 summer transfer window. Loan moves and unconfirmed transfer reports do not qualify. 
  Resolution Date : The date the permanent transfer is first publicly confirmed. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the acquiring football club.
